name: AR_UPD_REF_ACCOUNTS
description: AR_UPD_REF_ACCOUNTS contains customer reference account interface data entered into a simplified customer spreadsheet template for upload.

columns.name: REFACCT_UPLOAD_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier for a customer upload record.

columns.name: BATCH_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier for a customer import batch process.

columns.name: CUST_ORIG_SYSTEM
columns.description: Original system identifier for the customer account.

columns.name: ORIG_SOURCE_SYSTEM_NAME
columns.description: Name of the source system used to load data into the TCA registry.

columns.name: CUST_ORIG_SYSTEM_REFERENCE

columns.name: CUST_SITE_ORIG_SYS_REF

columns.name: CUST_SITEUSE_ORIG_SYS_REF

columns.name: ORG_ID
columns.description: Indicates the identifier of the business unit associated to the row.

columns.name: ACCOUNT_NUMBER
columns.description: Number of the customer account.

columns.name: PARTY_SITE_NUMBER
columns.description: Number of the party site. This number indicates unique reference of the addresses associated to a party.

columns.name: LEDGER_ID
columns.description: Unique ledger identifier for the reference account.

columns.name: REF_ACCOUNT_CCID
columns.description: Unique identifier for the reference account.

columns.name: SITE_USE_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier of the customer address purpose.

columns.name: INSERT_UPDATE_FLAG
columns.description: Insert update indicator. Valid values are I and U. I means the customer does not exist and that the customer information must be imported for the first time. U means the customer exists and that only specific customer information must be updated.

columns.name: ACCOUNT_TYPE
columns.description: Account class for this reference account.

columns.name: LOAD_REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the interface load job that created the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: UPLOAD_REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the parent job that processes this record.

columns.name: UPLOAD_STATUS
columns.description: Indicates the upload status of this record.

columns.name: FILE_RECORD_NUM
columns.description: This column is used by the import wizard to relate a record in the interface table to the file row.
